title: agentdag node spec
description: What the planner emits and the coordinator validates and dispatches (design 2.1). One object per node in a workflow graph.

node_id.description: Unique identifier of this node within the run's graph.

kind.description: The DISPATCHED primitive this node runs (design 2.1, 4). Only dispatched kinds are listed: the coordinator-code patterns until-pass, until-dry, route and vote get no node record and are control flow in the workflow program, compact is a field on work, and deadline_s is a per-node scheduler field.

brief_ref.description: A path in the run store to the node's brief (objective, output schema, tool/source guidance, explicit boundaries), validated to resolve INSIDE the run store after realpath (2.4). Input is built from the store by a filter, never pasted whole; the assembled input is written to input.json in the node dir and its hash is part of the journal key (3.2).

executor.description: 'claude', 'code' for a code-executed kind (gate, reduce, wait, stage, apply, approve), or 'mcp:<server>/<tool>' addressing an MCP-exposed executor such as 'mcp:codex/codex'. Absent on map and batch, which the coordinator performs itself (design 2.1, C1).

tier_role.description: The role the tier policy resolves to a model row (design 2.1, 2.3). NULL for every code-executed kind and for map/batch, which resolve no model row - a map's standard default belongs to its BODY nodes.

model.description: Optional stable alias (e.g. haiku, sonnet, opus, fable, codex), never a pinned version. The planner may override the tier-role default per node with a one-line reason (2.3 rule 3).

effort.description: Optional reasoning-effort knob. Only used at the extremes by default (2.3 rule 6).

knowledge.description: knowledge-index dataset names this node may read (2.1), one of the namespaces of design 3.7. Enters the journal key as the allowed list (3.2). NOT IN SLICE 1: needs the knowledge-index project's 4.4 (filter port) and 4.9 (staging queue); see ../../../PLANS/build-plan-high.md cuts.

stage_into.description: The single knowledge-index dataset this node may WRITE to (2.1). Validated explicitly (2.4) and part of the journal key (3.2), because changing where a node writes makes it a different call. NOT IN SLICE 1, with knowledge.

write_set.description: PATHS (globs) the node may create, edit or delete - enforced by the PreToolUse hook / Codex workspace-write sandbox and by the post-node ISOLATION-ROOT scan (design 5, 3.6). Confined to the node's own dir, except that a reduce may name manifest/, a stage intents/, and a reduce or synth artefacts/ (3.1). Shared resources are NOT here; see requires.

requires.description: Shared resources the node consumes, scheduled by admission against the HOST-LEVEL lease store (design 3.6): mutex (capacity 1), capacity in a unit, or rate over a window. Enters the journal key. In slice 1 the only registered resource is the bmk-tool-env mutex.

isolation.description: Isolation mode: worktree (default for work, cloned from a bare mirror under the run dir with core.fileMode=false), dir, or none. 'dir' runs the node in an EXISTING directory rather than a fresh worktree - typically a preceding node's worktree in the same branch (a gate running make test or an isolation-root scan against a work node's own checkout) - writing only inside its own declared write_set and creating nothing new under the run root. 'none' means NO worktree and no working dir of its own - such a node still writes, but only into its own artefact dir nodes/<node_id>/<hash8>/artefacts/ and, for its kind, the run-root prefixes of 3.1 (design 2.1, C8).

deps.description: node_ids that must be done before this node dispatches; validated to exist and to leave the graph acyclic (2.1, 2.4).

deadline_s.description: Per-node deadline in seconds (2.1, 3.4). A limit, not an input: not part of the journal key (3.2).

budget.description: Per-node budget. Tokens per model row are the MEASURED and capped quantity (design 2.1/3.4, decided 2026-08-17); usd is an optional derived ceiling that binds only metered rows. Limits are NOT part of the journal key.

tokens.description: row alias -> token cap for this node on that row

usd.description: Optional derived-USD ceiling. It binds ONLY a row whose usd_per_mtoken values are non-null; on a row priced null (the codex row as shipped) the USD cap is unavailable and a budget.usd is rejected at validation (design 2.3, M4).

compact.description: For a long serial work node: the executor is asked to compress its own history at trigger_tokens, keeping the last keep_last_n turns/messages (2.1, section 4 'compact').

trigger_tokens.description: Token count at which the executor is asked to compact its own history.

keep_last_n.description: Number of most recent turns/messages to keep uncompacted.

attempt.description: 0 on first dispatch, incremented on retry/escalation; enters the journal key so a re-dispatch after failed is not served from the journal (2.1).

allOf.title: map and batch carry no executor and no tier_role
every other kind names its executor
a code-executed node resolves no model row
a model-executed node has a tier role
